example_en: The family had to [abandon] their car in the deep snow.
example_zh: 一家人不得不把车丢弃在深雪里。

example_en: Many villages still have no [access] to clean water.
example_zh: 许多村庄仍然无法获得干净的水。

example_en: The two countries want to [maintain] good relations.
example_zh: 两国希望保持良好关系。

example_en: There has been a [significant] increase in online shopping.
example_zh: 网购出现了显著增长。

example_en: Her [approach] to teaching grammar is practical and clear.
example_zh: 她教语法的方法实用而清晰。

example_en: A stranger began to [approach] us in the dark street.
example_zh: 一个陌生人在黑暗的街上开始向我们走近。

example_en: Housing costs are the main [issue] for young workers.
example_zh: 住房成本是年轻工人面临的主要问题。

example_en: The bank will [issue] new cards to all customers.
example_zh: 银行将向所有客户发放新卡。

example_en: The police found no [evidence] of a break-in.
example_zh: 警方没有发现闯入的证据。

example_en: Regular exercise can [contribute] to better sleep.
example_zh: 规律锻炼有助于改善睡眠。

example_en: One [benefit] of living in the city is easy transport.
example_zh: 住在城市的一个好处是交通便利。

example_en: Good communication is [crucial] in a crisis.
example_zh: 危机中良好的沟通至关重要。

example_en: His answer was [ambiguous], so we asked him again.
example_zh: 他的回答模棱两可，所以我们又问了一遍。

example_en: Engineers try to [anticipate] problems before they happen.
example_zh: 工程师努力在问题发生前预见它们。

example_en: Neither side was willing to make a [compromise].
example_zh: 双方都不愿意妥协。

example_en: Rising sea levels are one [consequence] of global warming.
example_zh: 海平面上升是全球变暖的后果之一。

example_en: He told a [deliberate] lie to protect his friend.
example_zh: 他为了保护朋友故意撒了谎。

example_en: Washing your hands helps [eliminate] harmful germs.
example_zh: 洗手有助于消除有害细菌。

example_en: The sun began to [emerge] from behind the clouds.
example_zh: 太阳开始从云后露出来。

example_en: After the illness, her health remained [fragile].
example_zh: 病后她的身体仍然虚弱。

example_en: With so little rain, a water shortage seemed [inevitable].
example_zh: 降雨这么少，缺水似乎不可避免。

example_en: The police decided to [intensify] their search.
example_zh: 警方决定加强搜寻。

example_en: Some people reject the [notion] that failure is useful.
example_zh: 有些人不接受失败有益这一观念。

example_en: The details of the agreement are still [obscure].
example_zh: 协议细节仍不清楚。

example_en: Doctors warned that the symptoms may [persist] for weeks.
example_zh: 医生警告症状可能持续数周。

example_en: Many shoppers are [reluctant] to pay more for green products.
example_zh: 许多顾客不愿为环保产品多付钱。

example_en: The children began to [scatter] when the rain started.
example_zh: 下雨时孩子们开始四散跑开。

example_en: Old computer systems are [vulnerable] to attacks.
example_zh: 旧计算机系统容易受到攻击。

example_en: The company decided to [withdraw] its offer.
example_zh: 公司决定撤回报价。

example_en: She works at a [bank] in the city centre.
example_zh: 她在市中心的一家银行工作。

example_en: The boat was tied to the [bank] near the bridge.
example_zh: 船系在桥附近的岸边。

example_en: The teacher gave every student a [fair] chance to speak.
example_zh: 老师给每个学生公平的发言机会。

example_en: We bought fresh honey at the village [fair].
example_zh: 我们在村里的集市上买了新鲜蜂蜜。

example_en: Always carry a [spare] key in case you lose yours.
example_zh: 总要带一把备用钥匙，以防丢了自己的。

example_en: I cannot [spare] the time to watch the whole film.
example_zh: 我抽不出时间看完整部电影。

example_en: Dust tends to [accumulate] under the bed.
example_zh: 灰尘容易积在床下。

example_en: The manager will [allocate] tasks to each member.
example_zh: 经理会给每个成员分配任务。

example_en: We should not [assume] that the data is correct.
example_zh: 我们不应假定数据是正确的。

example_en: He will [assume] the role of team leader next year.
example_zh: 他明年将担任团队负责人。

example_en: The report lacks a [coherent] structure.
example_zh: 这份报告缺乏条理清楚的结构。

example_en: Scientists [conceive] an idea first and then test it.
example_zh: 科学家先构想一个想法，然后加以检验。

example_en: The decision to close the library caused [controversy].
example_zh: 关闭图书馆的决定引发了争议。

example_en: The number of birds in the area continues to [decline].
example_zh: 该地区鸟类数量持续减少。

example_en: She chose to [decline] the job offer from the bank.
example_zh: 她选择婉拒那家银行的工作邀请。

example_en: The pain will [diminish] after a few days.
example_zh: 几天后疼痛会减轻。

example_en: It is hard to [distinguish] the twins from each other.
example_zh: 很难区分这对双胞胎。

example_en: Please do not [exaggerate] the size of the problem.
example_zh: 请不要夸大问题的严重性。

example_en: There is a [fundamental] difference between the two plans.
example_zh: 两个计划之间存在根本差异。

example_en: Their [hypothesis] was supported by the new data.
example_zh: 他们的假说得到了新数据的支持。

example_en: The [implication] of his remark was that we had failed.
example_zh: 他话里的意思是我们失败了。

example_en: Free meals are an [incentive] for students to attend.
example_zh: 免费餐是吸引学生参加的激励。

example_en: The results [justify] the time we spent on the project.
example_zh: 结果证明我们在项目上花的时间是值得的。

example_en: He was accused of trying to [manipulate] the election results.
example_zh: 他被指控试图操纵选举结果。

example_en: A [preliminary] report will be ready next week.
example_zh: 一份初步报告下周就绪。

example_en: I am [skeptical] about promises of quick weight loss.
example_zh: 我对快速减肥的承诺持怀疑态度。

example_en: Rumours can [undermine] trust within a team.
example_zh: 谣言会削弱团队内部的信任。

example_en: The new farming method may [yield] larger harvests.
example_zh: 新的耕作方法可能带来更大的收成。

example_en: After a long argument, he decided to [yield].
example_zh: 经过长时间争论，他决定让步。

example_en: The price includes flights and [accommodation].
example_zh: 价格包括机票和住宿。

example_en: Students learn to [analyse] poems in this course.
example_zh: 学生在这门课上学习分析诗歌。

example_en: Scientists study the [behaviour] of bees in winter.
example_zh: 科学家研究蜜蜂冬季的行为。

example_en: My [colleague] helped me finish the report.
example_zh: 我的同事帮我完成了报告。

example_en: I [commute] by bike when the weather is good.
example_zh: 天气好时我骑车通勤。

example_en: The new [curriculum] includes more science lessons.
example_zh: 新课程包含更多科学课。

example_en: We worked late to meet the [deadline].
example_zh: 我们加班到很晚以赶上截止日期。

example_en: Plastic waste is harmful to the [environment].
example_zh: 塑料垃圾对环境有害。

example_en: The hotel has a laundry [facility] for guests.
example_zh: 酒店为客人提供洗衣设施。

example_en: Most students [graduate] after four years of study.
example_zh: 大多数学生学习四年后毕业。

example_en: He is a recent [graduate] looking for his first job.
example_zh: 他是一名刚毕业、正在找第一份工作的毕业生。

example_en: Wetlands provide a [habitat] for many birds.
example_zh: 湿地为许多鸟类提供栖息地。

example_en: The [itinerary] includes three days in Rome.
example_zh: 行程包括在罗马的三天。

example_en: The [landscape] changes completely in winter.
example_zh: 冬天景色完全改变。

example_en: Our [neighbourhood] has a small weekly market.
example_zh: 我们街区每周有个小市场。

example_en: Noise [pollution] can affect people's health.
example_zh: 噪音污染会影响人们的健康。

example_en: Many cities now [recycle] food waste.
example_zh: 许多城市现在回收利用厨余垃圾。

example_en: The train left on [schedule] despite the snow.
example_zh: 尽管下雪，火车仍按时刻表出发。

example_en: The university plans to raise [tuition] next year.
example_zh: 大学计划明年提高学费。

example_en: Every [volunteer] received a free T-shirt.
example_zh: 每位志愿者都得到了一件免费 T 恤。

example_en: Can you help me [organise] my notes?
example_zh: 你能帮我整理笔记吗？
